purpose: Replace representation-dependent false failures while preserving raw-byte provenance and all scientific/numerical gates.

receipt_object.algorithm: Recursively collect mapping objects containing every required_receipt_key; require exactly one.

stage_array.algorithm: Recursively collect nonempty arrays whose elements contain attempt_id, stage_index, execution_state, and work; require exactly one.

raw_discovery.kernel_arm: Collect all non-null kernel_arm values in the raw document and require one unique canonical arm.

source_identity.algorithm: Collect recursively from the entire raw envelope, require one unique 40-hex value for each. Do not require receipt-level duplicates.

tolerance.algorithm: Find every mapping containing the pair linear_rtol/linear_atol, or a tolerance mapping containing rtol/atol; require all discovered pairs to agree exactly with rtol=1e-10 and atol=1e-12.

outer_error.algorithm: If the top-level error key is absent or null, no error is recorded. A non-null value prevents COMPLETE migration.

legacy_signed_residual.none_present: Set every migrated signed_residual_digest to null and campaign signed_residual_coverage to LEGACY_NOT_RECORDED.
legacy_signed_residual.all_present: Copy the exact 64-hex values and set coverage to RECORDED.
legacy_signed_residual.mixed_presence: STOP_INVALID because partially recorded historical telemetry is ambiguous.
legacy_signed_residual.current_source_guard: The separately executed vector-aware signed-residual mutation test remains mandatory and is not inferred from legacy receipts.

raw_byte_identity.rule: SHA-256 the exact preserved raw file bytes; retain all twelve values in the handback.

numerical_payload_projection.rule: Derive all included values from raw evidence and SHA-256 the canonical JSON. Wrapper-supplied digests are never trusted.

campaign_semantics.audit_full_e_complete: Every eligible raw event must be completed with null failure.
campaign_semantics.unsafe_recommendations: Count raw events with recommended=true and audit_unsafe=true; COMPLETE requires zero.

identity_decision.byte_mismatch_only: PROVENANCE_OR_REPRESENTATION_EVENT; not a scientific failure by itself.
identity_decision.semantic_projection_mismatch: STOP_INVALID and name the differing scientific fields.
